subject: BlueWave marketplace acceptance / PO consolidation request
messages:
From: Maria Santos <maria.santos@bluewave.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@bluewave.ai
Date: Sun, 28 Mar 2027 08:13:22 -0700
Subject: Consolidating marketplace POs + capacity uplift request

Hi Jonas —

Thanks again for the call this morning. BlueWave is ready to move forward with a consolidated private-offer approach across AWS and GCP. We want to simplify procurement so one PO covers both clouds (same term), and increase committed capacity by ~40% for year 1 with a staged ramp into Q3.

High level asks:
- Single legal instrument or one master PO referencing platform private offers for AWS + GCP
- 12-month term starting 2027-05-01, with quarterly invoicing and a single tax/VAT flow
- Acceptance window: 30 days from signed PO to production activation; we need a guarantee that burst capacity is available during onboarding
- Requesting a templated invoice schedule and an estimated activation date by 2027-06-01

Attached: BlueWave_PO_Request_2027.pdf (spec sheet + initial SOW)

Can you loop in finance and legal so we can get a consolidated DocuSign route?

Best,
Maria Santos
Head of Procurement
BlueWave Labs

Forwarding BlueWave's request — they want to consolidate AWS + GCP private offers into a single procurement instrument and uplift year-1 committed capacity by ~40%.

Action items I see:
- Kimberly: can Redwood legal advise whether we do a master PO that references two marketplace private-offer SKUs, or whether we should create a single private-offer that maps to both clouds (procurement prefers single doc). Also want to confirm the SLA/burst wording for onboarding.
- Priyom: finance — can you draft an invoice cadence (quarterly) and indicate whether we can present a single tax/VAT flow for a cross-cloud consolidated PO? Also need to confirm how this maps to Marketplace metering and invoice ingestion for AWS vs. GCP.
- Laura: CS/onboarding — can you confirm activation target (they asked by 2027-06-01) and whether we can guarantee burst capacity for the first 30 days?

I attached the Redwood PO template I typically use for private offers (Redwood_PO_Template_v3.pdf) — you can redline and I will share back with BlueWave.

I'll coordinate with Maria on timeline once we have legal + finance sign-off.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Director, Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Thanks for the ping, Jonas. Quick notes from legal and procurement perspective: 

1) Contract approach: we can run a single master PO that references two marketplace private-offer SKUs (recommended). That keeps legal language minimal and keeps the cloud billing channels separate for the marketplace ingestion teams.
2) Term & invoicing: 12-month term effective 2027-05-01 with quarterly invoicing is fine. Finance will need the billing contact and tax jurisdiction (Maria, please confirm).
3) Acceptance & burst: we should define an onboarding SOW appendix that specifies a 30-day activation window and a defined burst pool. On our side, we can commit to a burst buffer for onboarding but will require a short-form addendum that details the burst metrics and cost exposure.

Next steps I propose: 
- Priyom, please prepare a draft invoice schedule (sample invoice amounts + dates) and confirm VAT/tax handling across US/EU if BlueWave has multi-jurisdiction operations.
- Jonas, forward the customer billing details and any purchasing contact name(s).
- I'll prepare a short legal addendum template for the burst pool and share for redline.

DocuSign: we'll use the standard PO flow via DocuSign. Internal ticket: PO-4721 (I put an intake task for finance to review).

Kimberly Park
Sr. Counsel, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference
